t: In front of you is a bronze statue of the Roman Emperor Trajan, made in the twentieth century. It stands at Tower Hill, in front of a section of the London Wall built by the Romans. Trajan ruled from the year 98 to 117 and is remembered as the second of the Five Good Emperors. He was a successful soldier, and under him the Roman Empire reached its greatest extent. The Senate gave him the title optimus princeps.
